situations.headline: PAC strategic review: Roc proposal rejected, River Capital deal pending, AGM catalyst Nov 2026

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: PAC strategic review: Roc proposal rejected, River Capital deal pending, AGM catalyst Nov 2026 (interest 7, risk 5)

thesis.text: PAC is an active special situation with competing inorganic proposals (Roc Partners rejected, River Capital under review at implied $13.00/share) against a backdrop of a formal strategic review overseen by independent directors and Flagstaff Partners. Outcome is binary and unconfirmed pending AGM-timed update; position sizing should reflect deal-break risk and lack of a firm floor price given Roc's rejection on fairness grounds.
